entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3562427951852172288: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 37.5225 +/- 0.0392 mas (same row, RUWE 1.12): 26.65 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -221.291, -58.841 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 3562427951852172288 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 9,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.182 +/- 0.007 solar radii from Peterson et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of LP 791-18 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023Natur.617..701P/abstract). Mass 0.139 +/- 0.005 solar masses from Peterson et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of LP 791-18 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023Natur.617..701P/abstract). Temperature 2960 +/- 55 K from Peterson et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of LP 791-18 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 2,960 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffb66b. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret (2017), A&A 600, A30 computes from PHOENIX model atmospheres for the TESS band at 2,960 K and log g 5.06 (u1 0.193, u2 0.527): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
